blocks.text: Jean Garcia has confirmed that she will portray Rovelyn Baterbonia, the mother of the late Ateneo basketball player Rene Baterbonia, in an upcoming biographical film about him. Garcia confirmed the casting during an ambush interview with reporters at the press conference for her new film, “Kusinerang Bulag.” “Yes, lumalabas naman na yun na ako, Rovelyn Baterbonia,” she said. The actress revealed that she had just returned from Davao City after shooting scenes for the film as its production nears its completion.
